title: Handling a chargeback dispute

steps.title: Pick up the new claim from the queue
Check the disputed transaction against the claim
Send the chargeback and start the evidence deadline
Set a reminder before the evidence deadline

decisions: If the cardholder has already contacted the merchant, choose the reason code (goods not received) and raise the chargeback; if not, ask them to contact the merchant first and put the case on hold for ten days.
If the disputed amount is under M$1,500, give provisional credit straight away; above that, the team lead must sign it off.
warnings: Watch the evidence deadline: if the reply window is missed, the scheme sides with the merchant and the provisional credit is reversed from the customer.
openQuestions: Whether the 30-day evidence deadline is calendar or working days under this year's scheme rules: Marcus will confirm with the scheme liaison team.
